value: You see a zombie approaching you!
You found your house and the zombie was not chasing you because you are protected now.
But then a mummy attacks you at the same time as the zombie!
You run away to find a better place to hide.
Another zombie came out of the gravestone when you did not know it was happening.
You find a gravestone to hide behind.
Then you go to bed in your nice warm bed because it was cold out.
